title: Readiness panel: renderFreezeNow retired, next-action command text removed
description: renderFreezeNow is replaced by renderFreezeState (plain words naming the failing gates from levels.readyToBuild.blockedBy when readyToBuild.ok is false; names what a freeze would record when ok). renderNextActionLine drops the Run command phrase. renderBlockersByPersona and its helpers (renderPersonaGroup, renderBlockerCard, buildIdWhyMap) are retired - the blocking table owns the blocker surface, the engineer DocRow body still carries renderStageDetail with per-check findings-lists so no id leaves the DOM. The null-readiness branch renders only the could-not-be-computed placeholder (AC-18003-6). The composed panel contains no shell command text or Freeze now control (AC-18003-7).
